name: power-platform-harness
description: Development standards and repository scaffolding for Power Platform / Dynamics 365 CE projects, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: power-platform-harness
plugins.description: Installs a Power Platform / Dynamics 365 CE development harness: agent instructions, per-technology development standards, a solution sync script and the expected folder layout. Scaffolds a new repository, or adopts an existing one by reading its publisher, prefix, solution and stack from the repository and the environment and reporting where they differ from the standards.
